_about: The ship tab of the airship screen. sheet: the drawing under the layers (pack path; web/art/blueprint_base.png is the base barge of tools/web_art.py). parts: the details that buildings bring, each its own layer on the drawing and its own model in 3D. building: the level without the prefix that brings it, null while the mod has no such building yet; enabled: connected on the page now (false: only the data is ready, the step to come is to set it true). Drawing layers: pencil, build, ink in web/art/layers.json or data/crew_ui_art.json (null: not drawn yet); turns_at: where the turns left are written while it is built, in units of the drawing (1040 x 760). model.part: build/web/models/<part>.gltf (tools/web_export.py); model.hides: nodes of the base hull it replaces; source: where the model comes from. stages: what the page shows at each stage of the ship, ?stage=<name> in the address; stage: the one shown without it. planks: the bare timber of the yard (tools/web_art.py, planks b), no buildings yet, no model; barge: the base barge with the guns' first building and the details. hull1: the hull's first level alone (sheets: the drawing per stage of sheet_part: bare timber, the same with the frame hatched over it, the frame; built: what stands at the start of this stage, overriding web/data/sim.json; demolish: the demolish button shown; frame_scheme: a scheme of keel and frames from three.js primitives in 3D while the frame stands, there is no model of it). tree: the stage's buildings as a tree (nodes: levels without the prefix; links from the data; direction: down, the first buildings on top, or up). tree_demo: the example shown by ?tree=demo; ?dir=up|down overrides the direction.
